WITH revenue_cte AS (
  SELECT SUM(product_price) AS revenue_2025
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
),
cost_cte AS (
  SELECT SUM(order_cost) AS cost_2025
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  (r.revenue_2025 - c.cost_2025) AS gross_profit_2025,
  (r.revenue_2025 - c.cost_2025) / r.revenue_2025 AS gross_margin_pct_2025
FROM revenue_cte r, cost_cte c;
